source: Create a minigolf game that can be played across devices. The game should allow players to create and discover lobbies, lobbies should have settings like enabling collision between player balls. The controls are basically being able to aim left and right and then hold and release for power of shot. While the ball can move in any direction, the shot will only move the ball on the golf course itself. Create 15 courses, have par scores for each course and track the score for each player through leaderboard.

answers.ask: No look was given — should these be classic mini-golf windmills-and-astroturf, or something stylized?
answers.answer: Use a classic mini-golf look with astroturf lanes, simple colorful obstacles, and windmill-style course decoration.

answers.ask: Are the fifteen courses one connected park you walk between, or separate places you are teleported into?
answers.answer: Make the fifteen courses separate holes players are teleported into in sequence; this keeps the game compact and focused.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: No look was given — should these be classic mini-golf windmills-and-astroturf, or something stylized? A: Use a classic mini-golf look with astroturf lanes, simple colorful obstacles, and windmill-style course decoration.
- [author] scale — Q: Are the fifteen courses one connected park you walk between, or separate places you are teleported into? A: Make the fifteen courses separate holes players are teleported into in sequence; this keeps the game compact and focused.
- [agent_inferred] hole footprint — Q: How large is each separate hole? A: Keep every hole small and self-contained, with one tee, one bounded lane, and one cup.

## Enriched image prompt
Create exactly 15 distinct compact mini-golf hole maps in a classic colorful style, each built as a self-contained astroturf lane with one tee at the start and one cup at the end. Bound every lane with simple low walls so the ball remains on the course. Distribute clear, colorful geometric obstacles across the 15 holes and use windmill-style decoration where it fits, while preserving a playable shot route from each tee to its cup. Treat every hole as a separate stage rather than one connected walking park.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Sports.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-chaptered`, taken from outside Sports' usual shape set, because the 15 holes are genuinely separate maps entered in sequence. Use the Target Sport preset but substitute the separate-stage shape and drop distance markers; retain the directed tee-to-cup scoring layout.

## Config requirements
Use the visible half of `startpoint-play` as exactly 15 tee positions, one per hole. Use the visible half of `trigger-scoring` as exactly 15 cups, one per hole. Use the visible half of `trigger-bounds` as low course walls enclosing each of the 15 astroturf lanes. Use the visible half of 14 `teleporter-link` pairs as restrained transfer markers joining each completed hole to the next tee. Draw the colorful obstacles and windmill-style decorations as scene-specific course geometry.

## Layout requirements
Place 15 `startpoint-play` ball reset positions, one at each tee. Place 15 `trigger-scoring` cup volumes, one at the end of each hole. Place 15 `trigger-bounds` perimeters aligned to the low lane walls. Place 14 `teleporter-link` pairs, each departing beside the completed cup on Hole 1 through Hole 14 and arriving at the next hole's tee. Add one scene-specific TriggerZone completion marker at the fifteenth cup. Par scores, lobby discovery, settings, and the leaderboard are not physical placements.

## Layout components
The build contains exactly 15 separate compact map segments named Hole 1 through Hole 15, each using `range-directed`. Every segment has one astroturf lane, one tee, one cup, one enclosing low-wall perimeter, and its own arrangement of simple colorful obstacles; windmill-style decoration recurs across the set. Frame each hole independently so its complete playable line is visible.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: each tee-to-cup route, boundary, obstacle arrangement, and sequence endpoint must be authoritative before the classic mini-golf styling is applied.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large in aggregate—15 separate small holes—while each individual map remains compact. The theme is classic mini-golf with astroturf, colorful simple obstacles, and windmill-style decoration. Use `P4` because the 15 holes are separate maps rather than one surface.
